violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -Ice scoop laying in ice.
Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --No dish soap available for utensil washing.
Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. -Hand sanitizer instead of hand soap at hand sink.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Poisonous or toxic material was not stored in a manner to protect against contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items. -Single use gloves stored in sink basin with bleach bottle.--Simple green jug (emptied and rinsed before use) used for chlorine solution but still smells like simple green.--Unapproved poison or toxic material was observed in food establishment. -Facility using low splash bleach for sanitizer solutions.
